text:
ravi: heads up — got a noisy spike in pending GPU pods in ap-southeast1 this morning, looks related to affinity threshold changes rolled yesterday
cheng: ack, saw alerts. autoscaler also bumped a couple of racks which made packing worse :/
sara: can you paste the pod list? wondering if it's tiny-gang or large training jobs
ravi: sure — quick grab:
```
kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=trainer -o wide | grep Pending
trainer-epoch-42-0   Pending   0/4 nodes  0s
trainer-epoch-7-0    Pending   0/2 nodes  0s
```
jordan: those look like gang-scheduled jobs with strict nodeAffinity for nvlink groups
ops-bot: autoscaler: scaled up 3 nodes in ap-southeast1-a at 09:12 UTC (policy: cost-balanced)
cheng: cost-balanced policy is the culprit — it spread capacity across AZs to save money but affinity needs co-located NVLink pairs
mike: tl;dr: scheduler puts pods on same AZ for affinity, autoscaler provisioned separate AZs -> fragmentation + evictions when we try to coalesce
sara: any evictions observed?
ravi: yes, a couple of soft evicts on warmpool handoffs. logs show "taint mismatch" then requeue
```
W scheduler: preempting pod X due to taint/capacity mismatch
E kubelet: Evicted pod trainer-epoch-7-0, reason: NodeAffinity
```
cheng: propose: temporarily flip autoscaler policy to "zone-constrained" for ap-southeast1 to respect NVLink affinity while we evaluate slot-coalescer perf
jordan: +1, also we should lower affinity threshold from 0.9 to 0.7 for tiny-gang jobs to increase packing flexibility
mike: downside: lowering threshold may increase cross-AZ traffic for some multi-gpu models — need telemetry window
ops-bot: action created: INF-3282 — adjust autoscaler policy and run coalescer dry-run (assignee: cheng)
cheng: I'll run a simulated dry-run in staging and report expected plateaus. quick plan: flip policy for 30m, watch pending count and eviction rate
sara: if flipping fixes pending within 10m, we can extend. also, let's add an alert for "pending_gang_pods > 5 for 5m"
ravi: doing a manual scale-down rollback if it worsens. ping me if you flip so I can watch the trainer queue
jordan: also file to revisit scheduling heuristics — maybe special-casing NVLink affinity in the binpacker rather than relying only on nodeAffinity
mike: agree, long-term fix is binpacker aware of topo groups + warm-pool co-location contract
cheng: flipping now (starting 09:32 UTC) — will post numbers in ~10m
ops-bot: deploy-bot: autoscaler policy changed in ap-southeast1 to zone-constrained by cheng at 09:32 UTC
ravi: seeing 3 pending -> 0 in last 6m, evictions stopped. nice
sara: great, keep an eye for any cost blips this window
cheng: will follow up with staging dry-run results and a proposal for a scheduler heuristic PR
mike: thanks all — INF-3282 updated with notes
